theory: Hardy turns mathematical conversations into evidence-bearing artifacts while separating formal verification, informal faithfulness, document compilation, and computational exploration. Its organizing rule is that an artifact’s identity and recorded evidence constrain what the system may claim; providers and presentation supply input and execution rather than authority.
instead_of: Build a general autonomous-agent framework or judge success from polished model output; the code instead develops one concrete Lean-centered experiment with explicit evidence and known execution limits.

absorption.rationale: More local tools, premise sources, and UI adapters fit named boundaries, but hosting independent concurrent sessions or replacing a whole interactive capability still crosses process-global cancellation and concrete coordinator construction.

world_mapping.rationale: Formal claims, documents, literature, CAS state, corpus content, experimental conditions, and workflow decisions now have recognizable owners and distinct records of authority.

abstraction.rationale: The system has strong evidence and state-owner abstractions, while the large interactive coordinator and application configuration dependency remain places where changes require knowledge across capabilities.

justification.rationale: Reasons are recoverable in code: independent reconstruction, contextual faithfulness isolation, conservative experiment digests, and descriptor-owned locks explain the rejected alternatives.

honest_limits.rationale: The code distinguishes recorded evidence from truth, output agreement from full CAS reproduction, stale procedure identity from reuse, and guarded files from execution isolation.

rehearsals.requirement: Add a bounded premise-retrieval service shared by staged and interactive runs.
rehearsals.why: The formal source protocol and bounded Lean tool runtime supply an existing capability boundary.

rehearsals.requirement: Add an evidence-only report over already saved experiment boards.
rehearsals.why: Recorded readers and source-identity exclusions make report construction distinct from launching experiments.

rehearsals.requirement: Host two independent interactive workspaces in one service and cancel just one.
rehearsals.why: Workspaces have separate state owners, but global child cancellation and session-side concrete construction need another ownership boundary.
